_note: Part C hand-written resolved clauses (no LLM), frozen before the Part C simulation. Rules (PREREG Part C): every description of a paper is replaced by the paper's short method name from evals/research_ingestion/academic_corpus_manifest_v1.json (AdaPoinTr, Hyper-PCN, PCN, PF-Net, PointAttN, PoinTr, ProxyFormer, SeedFormer, SnowflakeNet, SVDFormer); the name replaces the whole noun phrase that describes the paper (including its relative clause / anaphor such as 'that earlier paper', '那篇方法'); main-clause predicates that the question needs as referents ('feeds noised ground-truth centers ... ; how does it keep those queries ...') are kept; elided predicates are restored with words copied from the sibling clause; no other word is added. 'name_only' = the R2 pieces with only the description->name substitution (no predicate restoration, no re-grouping of pieces). The per-clause added-word check is computed by partC.py check and written to resolved_clauses_check.json.
